logging_diff:
--- entrypoint.sh
+++ entrypoint.sh (stderr logging)
@@ -5,38 +5,38 @@
 
   # check for required envs
   if [[ -z "$RUNTIME" ]]; then
-    echo "[startup] RUNTIME not set, not able to execute. Must be either pypi or npm."
+    echo >&2 "[startup] RUNTIME not set, not able to execute. Must be either pypi or npm."
     exit 1
   elif [[ "$RUNTIME" != "pypi" && "$RUNTIME" != "npm" ]]; then
-    echo "[startup] RUNTIME must be either pypi or npm."
+    echo >&2 "[startup] RUNTIME must be either pypi or npm."
     exit 1
   fi
 
   if [[ -z "$PACKAGE" ]]; then
-    echo "[startup] PACKAGE not set, not able to execute."
+    echo >&2 "[startup] PACKAGE not set, not able to execute."
     exit 1
   fi
 
   if [[ "$RUNTIME" == "pypi" ]]; then
-    echo "[startup] Setting up Python environment"
+    echo >&2 "[startup] Setting up Python environment"
     su -s /bin/bash -c "uv tool install -q $PACKAGE" mcpuser
     EXE="uv tool run $PACKAGE"
   elif [[ "$RUNTIME" == "npm" ]]; then
-    echo "[startup] Setting up Node.js environment"
+    echo >&2 "[startup] Setting up Node.js environment"
     npm init -y > /dev/null
     npm install $PACKAGE > /dev/null
     EXE="npm exec $PACKAGE"
   fi
-  echo "[startup] Installed '$PACKAGE', set EXE to '$EXE'."
+  echo >&2 "[startup] Installed '$PACKAGE', set EXE to '$EXE'."
 
 else
 
   if [[ -z "$EXE" ]]; then
-    echo "[startup] PRE_INSTALLED is set, but EXE is not defined. Please set EXE to the command to run."
+    echo >&2 "[startup] PRE_INSTALLED is set, but EXE is not defined. Please set EXE to the command to run."
     exit 1
   fi
 
-  echo "[startup] Using mounted/preinstalled environment, do not execute any setup steps. EXE is set to '$EXE'."
+  echo >&2 "[startup] Using mounted/preinstalled environment, do not execute any setup steps. EXE is set to '$EXE'."
 
 fi
 
@@ -49,7 +49,7 @@
 ALLOW_LOOPBACK="${ALLOW_LOOPBACK:-1}"
 
 if [[ -z "$ALLOWED_EGRESS" ]]; then
-  echo "[startup] ALLOWED_EGRESS is empty. No outbound connections allowed."
+  echo >&2 "[startup] ALLOWED_EGRESS is empty. No outbound connections allowed."
 fi
 
 is_ipv4 () { [[ "$1" =~ ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}$ ]]; }
@@ -75,14 +75,14 @@
       done < <(getent ahosts "$host" | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u)
     fi
   else
-    echo "Invalid ALLOWED_EGRESS entry: '$entry' (expected host:port or ip:port)" >&2
+    echo >&2 "Invalid ALLOWED_EGRESS entry: '$entry' (expected host:port or ip:port)" >&2
     exit 2
   fi
 done
 
 mapfile -t DEST_IP_PORT_PAIRS < <(printf "%s\n" "${DEST_IP_PORT_PAIRS[@]}" | sort -u)
 
-echo "[startup] setup iptables"
+echo >&2 "[startup] setup iptables"
 
 iptables -F INPUT
 iptables -F OUTPUT
@@ -92,7 +92,7 @@
 
 # Allow loopback (both directions) — many apps expect it
 if [[ "$ALLOW_LOOPBACK" == "1" ]]; then
-  echo "[startup] Allowing loopback traffic"
+  echo >&2 "[startup] Allowing loopback traffic"
   iptables -A INPUT -i lo -j ACCEPT
   iptables -A OUTPUT -o lo -j ACCEPT
 fi
@@ -112,7 +112,7 @@
 )
 
 for dns in "${DNS_LIST_ARR[@]}"; do
-  echo "[startup] Allowing DNS queries to: $dns"
+  echo >&2 "[startup] Allowing DNS queries to: $dns"
   iptables -A OUTPUT -p udp -d "$dns" --dport 53 -j ACCEPT
   iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp -d "$dns" --dport 53 -j ACCEPT
 done
@@ -122,15 +122,15 @@
   [[ -z "$pair" ]] && continue
   ip="${pair%%:*}"
   port="${pair##*:}"
-  echo "[startup] Allowing outbound connections to: $pair"
+  echo >&2 "[startup] Allowing outbound connections to: $pair"
   iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp -d "$ip" --dport "$port" -j ACCEPT
 done
 
-echo "[startup] Execute ${RUNTIME} with pkg: '${PACKAGE}' and args: '$*'"
+echo >&2 "[startup] Execute ${RUNTIME} with pkg: '${PACKAGE}' and args: '$*'"
 
 if id mcpuser >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   exec su -s /bin/bash -c "${EXE} $*" mcpuser
 else
-  echo "User mcpuser does not exist"
+  echo >&2 "User mcpuser does not exist"
   exit 1
 fi
